pr_body:
This commit introduces a processor that will ingest a stream given a
list of partition addresses. This initial version is the minimum changes
required to ingest these KVs, and as a result some simplifications were
made.

KVs are buffered until a checkpoint event is received (for any
partition). The KVs are currently also only ever flushed upon receiving
a checkpoint event.

The flow will terminate when the event channels provided by the
streaming client close, which is not expected to happen when normally
interaction with the ingestion job.

Closes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/57398.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/58513)

issue_context.title: streaming: add stream partition ingestion processors
issue_context.body:
Cluster-to-cluster streams will be ingested via stream partition processors. It will have access to a streaming client which will provide the events for the stream, as well as the address(es) of the partitions to ingest.

The initial version of the processor should just buffer and ingest incoming KVs.
